title.hr: Točka, dužina, polupravac i pravac; sjecište
title.en: Point, segment, ray and line; lines that meet

concept.hr: Pravac nema kraja i ne nacrta se cijeli; dva pravca se sijeku ili su usporedni
concept.en: A line has no end and can never be drawn whole; two lines cross or are parallel

summary.hr: Produlji dužinu u polupravac i pravac, odluči pripada li T pravcu p, okreći pravac dok sjecište ne pobjegne, nacrtaj ∥ i ⊥ trokutom.
summary.en: Lengthen a segment into a ray and a line, decide if T lies on line p, turn a line till the crossing runs away, draw ∥ and ⊥.

title.hr: Sijeku li se p i q? Sjecište izvan papira
title.en: Do p and q cross? A crossing off the paper

concept.hr: Pravci koji se na papiru ne sijeku nisu zato usporedni
concept.en: Lines that do not cross on the paper are not parallel for that

title.en: A parallel line with a ruler and a set square

concept.hr: Trokut klizi uz ravnalo bez okretanja, pa mu rub ostaje usporedan s p
concept.en: The set square slides along the ruler, not turning: its edge stays parallel to p
